title: Smart Data Models - EDINT City Agenda - CityEvent
description: An event that will take place in a city, e.g. a cultural, sports or social activity published in a municipal public agenda (edintagenda:CityEvent, subclass of geosparql:Feature and schema:Event).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CityEvent'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code identifying the event in the source data (dct:identifier), e.g. '50280843'.

startDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The date and time the event starts (schema:startDate). Inherited from Event.

endDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The date and time the event ends (schema:endDate). Inherited from Event.

address.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/address'. The mailing address of the event venue.

isAccessibleForFree.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/isAccessibleForFree'. Whether attending the event is free of charge. Not formally declared as a property in this ontology's own ontology.ttl, but used in the source's own real example data (reusing the genuine schema.org term directly); included per that real usage.

eventStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/eventStatus'. Current status of the event, from the EventStatus controlled vocabulary. NOTE: this ontology's own ontology.ttl formally declares an 'eventStatus' property under its own agenda# namespace, but the source's own real example data instead uses the genuine schema.org 'eventStatus' term directly. Modeled here under schema:eventStatus, per the real, demonstrated usage; see standard-metadata.yaml.

attendanceMode.description: Property. Attendance mode -- in person, online, or mixed -- from the AttendanceMode controlled vocabulary (edintagenda:attendanceMode).

eventType.description: Property. Type of event, from the EventType controlled vocabulary (edintagenda:eventType). Includes both the 3 top-level categories (Cultural, Sports, Social) and 5 narrower concepts (e.g. Concierto/Concert, a narrower term under Cultural) -- the source's own KOS scheme mixes both levels without excluding the broader ones from direct use, and the real example data instantiates a narrower concept (Ferias) directly.

schedule.description: Property. The schedule of the event specifying the hours each day (edintagenda:schedule). The source ontology does not constrain this to a structured format; the real example uses a comma-separated day-of-week abbreviation list.

documentation.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/DigitalDocument'. A document with more information about the event (edintagenda:documentation).

takesPlaceIn.description: Relationship. The venue (edint-infraestructura's Facility) where the event takes place (edintagenda:takesPlaceIn).

organizedBy.description: Relationship. The Organization that manages the event (edintagenda:organizedBy).

isHeldIn.description: Relationship. The administrative entity (e.g. Barrio, Distrito, Municipio) where the event is held (edintagenda:isHeldIn). These territorial classes are external and not modeled by this candidate family; kept as an opaque Relationship.

interior.description: Property. Whether the event takes place in an enclosed location (edintagenda:interior).

price.description: Property. The price of the event (edintagenda:price). The source ontology does not constrain this to a structured currency format.
